glosses: inhabitant (someone or thing who lives in a place)

examples.text: A aldeia tinha mais de mil habitantes.
examples.en: The village had more than a thousand residents.

examples.text: Os habitantes da ilha são amigáveis.
examples.en: The inhabitants of the island are friendly.

examples.text: A vila tinha mais de mil habitantes.
examples.en: The village had more than a thousand inhabitants.

examples.text: Os habitantes da cidade olharam para mim com curiosidade.
examples.en: The townspeople looked curiously at me.
